definitions.explanation: What happens as a result of an action or event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{結果|けっか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{努力|どりょく}した→努力：03490_doryoku⟧{結果|けっか}、⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功：02638_seikou⟧。
examples.english: As a result of my efforts, I succeeded.
examples.notes: 〜た{結果|けっか} = as a result of ~

notes:
Common word for discussing outcomes. Can also function as a conjunction meaning 'as a result.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {結果|けっか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (results come out)
- {結果|けっか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (produce results)
- ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{結果|けっか} (good results)
- ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{結果|けっか} (exam results)
- 〜の{結果|けっか} (as a result of ~)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Verb(た){結果|けっか}、〜 = As a result of doing ~, ...
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{結果|けっか} = as a result, consequently
